categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi Xinan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of lightweight aluminum alloy automotive components, focusing on precision compressor housings for turbochargers. The company also develops precision parts for new energy vehicles including motor housings, transmission housings, and inverter housings, serving mainly the automotive powertrain sector.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aluminum casting technologies including gravity casting, low-pressure casting, and high-pressure casting, combined with precision machining and automated assembly. It has developed proprietary mold design, aluminum melt refining, automated gravity casting, and integrated water channel sand core molding technologies, supported by over 200 patents. The production process emphasizes intelligent manufacturing and automation to ensure high quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global turbocharger manufacturers such as Garrett, Cummins, Ishikawajima-Harima, BorgWarner, and Bosch Mahle, whose engines are used by major automotive brands like Daimler, Audi, BMW, General Motors, Volkswagen, Ford, Toyota, Honda, and Nissan. The company also serves the power systems market, supplying aluminum housings for Siemens' high-voltage control equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, and has expanded internationally with a wholly-owned subsidiary in Thailand targeting the North American and Southeast Asian markets. Its products are exported to the United States, Europe, South Korea, Mexico, Japan, and other countries, reflecting a broad global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wuxi Xinan Technology operates as an upstream to midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, manufacturing key precision aluminum components for turbocharger manufacturers who then supply automotive OEMs. It procures raw aluminum billets and sand cores from established suppliers and outsources non-core processes like heat treatment to specialized contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in lightweight automotive aluminum components, focusing on turbocharger compressor housings and expanding into new energy vehicle parts such as hydrogen fuel cell motor housings and electric vehicle transmission components. It invests heavily in R&D, with nearly 49 million RMB spent in 2024, and emphasizes smart manufacturing, automation, and green production technologies to enhance competitiveness and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision aluminum components to tier-1 turbocharger manufacturers and new energy vehicle suppliers. The company employs a make-to-order production model based on customer contracts and project approvals, with sales conducted mainly via direct sales and consignment warehouses near customers to support just-in-time delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading global suppliers of precision compressor housings for turbochargers, competing with firms like Lihu Co., Ltd. and Yuanqing Aluminum Industry. It holds a significant market share domestically and internationally, supported by strong technical capabilities, stable customer relationships, and recognized quality, positioning it as a preferred supplier in the automotive lightweight aluminum parts sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 1.07 billion RMB, a 5.45% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 109.7 million RMB, up 17.77%. Total assets reached 1.88 billion RMB, with steady growth in production and sales volumes, including an 8.04% increase in precision compressor housing sales. The company maintains positive cash flows and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wuxi Xinan Technology offers high-precision, lightweight aluminum alloy components that enhance automotive fuel efficiency and reduce emissions, aligning with global automotive lightweighting and electrification trends. Its competitive advantages include advanced casting and machining technologies, extensive patent portfolio, strong quality control, and close collaboration with leading global turbocharger manufacturers, ensuring reliable, customized solutions with timely delivery.
